exercises.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: TWO-FRAME exercise sprite sheet for Gym Tracker. EXACTLY TWO EQUAL SQUARE PANELS side by side, aspect 2:1. NO divider, text, labels, arrows, ghost limbs or extra figures. Cut exactly in half and alternate like GIF. One full man plus whole pull-up station in EACH panel. Reference image guides equipment and character/style: adult man, short dark brown hair, sage green tank, dark green shorts, white trainers, clean dark outlines and flat subtle shading. Uniform very pale blue #EDF2FF to ALL edges with faint floor shadow. CRITICAL ALIGNMENT: bar, station uprights, hand grip positions, camera, scale and all stationary landmarks at EXACT same coordinates relative to each half. Do NOT recenter poses separately. Generous matching margins for widest/tallest pose; no cropped head, feet, hands or station. Anatomically coherent, only two arms and two legs. TUCK FRONT LEVER ISOMETRIC HOLD, three-quarter SIDE perspective with clear foreshortening. Use same accepted neutral grip reference: TWO SHORT PARALLEL HANDLES projecting forward from an ordinary overhead pull-up crossbar; palms facing each other shoulder-width, not hands gripping longitudinally like a sloth. Both arms STRAIGHT reaching diagonally upward to fixed handles, shoulders engaged. Athlete SUSPENDED UNDER bar, BACK facing the floor, looking upward, torso from shoulders to hips approximately HORIZONTAL, hips up in line with shoulders, both knees tightly tucked to chest and feet together. Entire station visible. Both frames show this SAME correct static hold at SAME location, only tiny natural breathing change in ribcage/shirt. No bent elbows, no pull-up, no inverted row, no gymnast on top of bar. Camera is eye-level SIDE OBLIQUE so overhead crossbar and projecting handles show distinct depth, not an impossible flat frontal tangle.
